title: Simple racing prototype
author: stempelo
selftext:
Hi, a simple prototype for a racing game. Developed using Codex and GPT 5-6.1.

I’m not sure if publishing it on GitHub would be useful to anyone, given that it’s AI-coded.

This is the link: [racing.poisearch.it](http://racing.poisearch.it)

Ciao from Italy!

comments.author: aigamedev-mod
comments.body: u/stempelo please add details on how AI was used to make this. Just stating that you used AI doesn't pass the rule. The community is a dev community, add dev details. Rule 4 is there to make sure promotional posts contribute by getting into the process and actual development. There's a real risk of the sub being swamped by self-promotion. If you don't update, this post may be removed.

replies.author: stempelo
replies.body: Sono partito da un modello molto semplice, un piano inclinato con una sfera descritto su codex cli. Volevo che fosse giocabile su browser, scelto quindi three.js e come motore fisico cannon.js. Il modello dell'auto è stato creato con freecad e mcp sempre con codex. Piccole modifiche alla volta e mirate. Fatto scrivere sempre la documentazione interna per ai. Ciao!

comments.author: Hitb1099
comments.body: dont worry about it being ai, if you spent time,effort and energy and you knpw its not slop like the other things then its good, every thing takes effort, people just like to hate on ai , theres nothing wrong with it being ai coded

replies.author: stempelo
replies.body: È più una prova per capire quanto complesso fosse arrivare ad un risultato simile.

comments.author: aigamedev-mod
comments.body:
Please see the requirements for posts about commercial games promotion.

**Game Promotion Posts Allowed, with Requirements**

You must discuss your game within the context of how it was developed using AI. Share with the community and give something for the community to talk about in your development experience with AI. A fire and forget video/image with no text, chatGPT bullet list may be removed by mods. If your game is being sold, you MUST apply the "Commercial Self Promotion" flair.

replies.body: Il gioco non è in vendita.
